import requests
from datetime import date

url = "https://dog.ceo/api/breeds/list/all"
json_text = requests.get(url, timeout=30).text

today = date.today().isoformat()
raw_dir = f"abfss://storagesynapsetestietest@accountsynapsetestietest.dfs.core.windows.net/Raw/dog_api/ingest_date={today}/"

# 1 bestand (part-file) met jouw JSON payload
spark.sparkContext.parallelize([json_text]).saveAsTextFile(raw_dir)

df = spark.read.json(raw_dir)
df.show(truncate=False)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

# df = jouw ingelezen raw json
fields = df.schema["message"].dataType.names

entries = F.array(*[
    F.struct(
        F.lit(f).alias("breed"),
        F.col(f"message.`{f}`").alias("subbreeds")
    )
    for f in fields
])

breeds_df = (
    df.select(F.explode(entries).alias("e"))
      .select("e.breed", "e.subbreeds")
)

# optioneel: 1 rij per subbreed
flat_df = (
    breeds_df
    .withColumn("subbreed", F.explode_outer("subbreeds"))
    .drop("subbreeds")
)

flat_df.show(20, truncate=False)

silver_path = "abfss://storagesynapsetestietest@accountsynapsetestietest.dfs.core.windows.net/Silver/dog_api/breeds_flat_delta/"

flat_df.write.mode("overwrite").format("delta").save(silver_path)

spark.sql("CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS sandbox")

spark.sql(f"""
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sandbox.dog_breeds
USING DELTA
LOCATION '{silver_path}'
""")
spark.sql("select * from sandbox.dog_breeds")

from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType, MapType, ArrayType
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

schema = StructType([
    StructField("message", MapType(StringType(), ArrayType(StringType())), True),
    StructField("status", StringType(), True),
])

df2 = spark.read.schema(schema).json(raw_dir)

breeds_df = (
    df2.select(F.explode(F.map_entries("message")).alias("kv"))
       .select(F.col("kv.key").alias("breed"),
               F.col("kv.value").alias("subbreeds"))
)

breeds_df.show(30, truncate=False)
